---
title: "SPEC-4.3.0-v001"
subtitle: "Close all tabs per group in the categorized views"
---

## Problem

The two grouped views — **Categorize by Website** (one section per domain,
e.g. `account.bambibaby.com`, `www.bambibaby.com`, `www.bowflex.com`) and
**Categorize with AI** (one section per Gemini category) — had no quick way
to get rid of a whole section. Closing every tab for a site meant closing
each tab individually, or checking them one by one (or via the heading's
right-click "Check All Tabs in Group") and then using "Close Checked".

## Feature

Every section heading in both grouped views gets a way to close all of the
tabs listed under it.

### "Close all N" link

- A small link — trash icon plus **"Close all N"**, where *N* is the number
  of tabs listed in that section — sits right after the section name in the
  heading. It is muted grey and turns red (underlined) on hover, so it does
  not compete with the section name visually.
- Tooltip: `Close all N tabs listed under "<section name>"`.
- Long section names truncate with an ellipsis rather than pushing the link
  off-screen.

### Context-menu item

The existing heading right-click menu ("Check All Tabs in Group", "Move Group
to New Window") gains a third, danger-styled item below a separator:
**"Close All Tabs in Group (N)…"**. It opens the same confirmation.

### Confirmation

Closing tabs cannot be undone, so both entry points open the standard
`ConfirmModal` (same pattern as "Close Checked" and "Close Window"):

- Title: **Close N Tabs?**
- Message: `This will close all N tabs listed under "<section name>" in your
  browser.`
- Warning: **This cannot be undone.**
- Confirm button: **Close N Tabs**. Escape / Cancel dismisses it.

### What gets closed

Exactly the tabs **listed** under the heading at the moment the link was
clicked — nothing more:

- If a search is active, only the section's matching (visible) tabs are
  closed; tabs the search hides stay open. The count *N* reflects this.
- Tabs outside the section — including other tabs from the same domain that
  were not part of the categorized scope — are untouched.

After closing:

- The closed tabs are removed from the checked-tabs set.
- If the selected (previewed) tab was closed, the selection is cleared.
- The tab list is reloaded and a toast reports "N tabs closed".
- Failures surface through the standard error modal ("Close Failed").
- The view stays in the grouped mode. In the website view the emptied
  section disappears naturally (website groups are recomputed from the open
  tabs).

## Related fix: stale tabs in AI groups

AI categories are a snapshot: their tab-ID lists are not recomputed when
tabs close. Previously, when there was no active search, `filteredTabGroups`
returned the snapshot unchanged, so a section whose tabs had all been closed
still rendered as an empty heading, and its stale IDs inflated counts.

`filteredTabGroups` now always drops IDs of tabs that no longer exist (using
an ID→tab `Map` instead of a linear `find` per ID) and drops sections left
empty. This keeps the "Close all N" count accurate and makes an emptied AI
category vanish just like an emptied website section. "Apply to Windows" is
unaffected — it still reads the unfiltered `tabGroups` / `websiteGroups`.

## Implementation notes

- `App.tsx`
  - New state `confirmCloseGroup: { name, tabIds } | null`.
  - New handler `handleCloseGroupTabs`, built on the existing
    `tabService.closeTabs` bulk close.
  - Heading markup in the grouped view adds the link (click uses
    `stopPropagation`); `openGroupContextMenu` adds the menu item.
  - `confirmCloseGroup` is included in the keyboard handler's "a modal is
    open" check so arrow keys / Enter don't act on the tab list behind the
    dialog.
- `README.md` (also rendered as the in-app User Guide) documents the link
  under *Categorizing Tabs → Refine*.

## Version

`package.json` / `manifest.json` bumped **4.2.1 → 4.3.0**.
